assumptions.statement: Among the sheets in docs/tasks only the in-flight work stays: this task's own sheet and the sheet of the still-open security-scan-repair-20261001 task; every other sheet in docs/tasks belongs to a terminal task.
A sheet is filed under its declared task id (the Task ID comment), not its file name: any sheet whose file name differs from its declared id is moved to <declared-id>.md.
The terminal home is the presence of the declared id's evidence directory: it exists means the sheet moves there, it does not means the sheet moves to the archive.
Moving a file with git mv keeps it tracked and changes no byte, so the freeze hashes, retained snapshots and finalization markers stay valid.

application: pipeline_tools/core.py: the retained-name and archive exemptions
domain: terminal sheets move to their evidence directory; terminal sheets with no evidence directory move to the archive; in-flight sheets stay in docs/tasks
interaction: pipeline_tools/planning.py: the three-location resolver delivered by the previous task
recovery: a sheet that cannot be classified by the mechanical rule stays in docs/tasks and is reported

non_goals: 不修改任何任务单的内容：只移动文件，字节必须逐字不变
不修改任何已最终化的 finalization.json 或其保留集内容
不重写 Git 历史：迁移是前向提交，不是改写既有提交
不触碰 pipeline_tools 下的任何实现代码
不为让检查变绿而删除任何任务单或证据文件

operations.scope: file every terminal task sheet under its declared task id, into its evidence directory or into the archive when it has none, leaving the two in-flight sheets in place
document that docs/tasks holds in-flight work only

unknowns.statement: Whether every sheet in docs/tasks belongs to a terminal task has not been re-derived by hand; sheets that the mechanical rule cannot classify must stay in docs/tasks and be listed rather than guessed.
